title: SATBench: Benchmarking LLMs’ Logical Reasoning via Automated Puzzle Generation from SAT Formulas

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error classification using an LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) to identify instances where models prematurely predict that a logical puzzle is satisfiable (SAT) but provide an invalid variable assignment, demonstrating a bias toward assuming satisfiability without exhaustively checking all constraints.
